# Security Policy

## Supported versions

PickVia currently provides security updates for the latest public release.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.2.x | Yes |
| 1.1.x and earlier | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a public GitHub issue or
discussion.

Use GitHub's private
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/kiteretsu903/pick-via/security/advisories/new)
form instead. Include the affected PickVia version, macOS version, steps to
reproduce the issue, its potential impact, and any suggested mitigation if
available.

You should receive an acknowledgment within seven days. After initial triage,
you will receive an update about whether the report is accepted and, when
possible, the expected remediation timeline. Please allow time for a fix to be
prepared and released before publishing details.

## Scope

Security reports may include issues that expose link contents, bypass routing
choices, misuse browser-profile access, execute unintended applications, or
otherwise compromise user data or system integrity.

General bugs, feature requests, and support questions should use the public
[issue tracker](https://github.com/kiteretsu903/pick-via/issues).
